svg.title: Four Core People, Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-origination-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core People, Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Base staffing is 1 FT + 3 C; scaled staffing is 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage represents one distinct person in the six-person scaled pod. The first four seats form the Conservative and Base pod; the final two are incremental scaled seats. C means contractor, not a full-time-equivalent commitment. External laboratories, survey firms, and escrow providers are purchased vendors rather than hidden pod employees.; caption: The principal owns underwriting and negotiations while specialists maintain independent technical and rights evidence.; stages: label: Principal and commercial lead; value: One full-time core owner leads transaction decisions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own sourcing priorities, option negotiation, developer relationships, exposure limits, revenue recognition coordination, and closing decisions. Keep purchase price and construction budgets outside operator fee reporting.; label: GIS and land research specialist; value: One core contractor maintains parcel evidence quality; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain QGIS parcel layers, FEMA overlays, wetland screening, zoning citations, ownership records, and source timestamps. Escalate conflicting records instead of allowing automated screening to imply verified capacity or final permitting.; label: Utility and storage engineer; value: One core contractor validates technical power assumptions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Interpret utility correspondence, study scope, deliverable MW, charging profiles, upgrade allocation, restudy sensitivity, and energization dependencies. Distinguish preliminary technical estimates from executed service commitments.; label: Real-estate transaction counsel; value: One core contractor structures rights and transfer evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review principal status, applicable brokerage statutes, title, option contingencies, assignment restrictions, mineral protections, expiration notices, and closing deliverables. Coordinate licensed brokerage services where the transaction requires them.; label: Development operations manager; value: One additional full-time person joins only at scale; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own milestone calendars, buyer diligence requests, study-document versioning, contractor schedules, and receipt reconciliation. Add this seat for the $900,000 scenario rather than silently increasing the four-person Base workload.; label: Land-use and environmental specialist; value: One additional contractor joins the scaled delivery pod; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate parcel-specific zoning, environmental investigation, local fire access, water constraints, and entitlement dependencies. The core pod buys limited site-specific services before this recurring scaled seat becomes justified.
